description: Box balloons (CBWoodringBox). No case had ever sent BM_ACTION, because the corpus modes were written as 0/1/2/4 - values that match neither BM_ (1/2/4/8, what ProcessLine actually forwards) nor SM_ (1..5). So the box balloon was never instantiated: measurably, no traj segment in any golden was a 'line', while CBWoodringBox::SetBalloonTraj builds its outline from four CLines instead of a spline plus two tail arcs. This case sends BM_ACTION (8) and BM_ACTION|BM_WHISPER (10, the dashed box). It also pins a distinction that is easy to port wrong: AddLine tests `uModes == BM_ACTION` by exact equality, so 8 starts a new panel and 10 does not.
